purpose: Independent second-wave generalization challenge. Expected HVAC reasoning defined before running frozen Brain 2.0.11.

cases.title: High SH without confirmed operating state

expected.system_check_result: High superheat needs operating-state confirmation
confirmed_findings: Evaporator superheat is high but operating state is not confirmed
expected.what_this_means: Superheat can mislead during startup, defrost, pump-down or recovery.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm active stable cooling and allow readings to stabilize before diagnosing refrigerant feed.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from high superheat alone.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Low SC without applicable model target

expected.system_check_result: Low subcooling reading needs configuration-aware interpretation
confirmed_findings: Subcooling is measured low against a non-applicable reference
expected.what_this_means: Receiver systems and measurement location can make generic subcooling targets unreliable.
expected.next_action_check: Use liquid condition, sight glass, restriction evidence and applicable equipment target before judging charge.
troubleshooting_path: Check liquid condition and leak/restriction evidence
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant solely from a generic subcooling target.

cases.title: Model target overrides generic reference

expected.system_check_result: Use the model-specific charging target
confirmed_findings: Generic reference conflicts with model target
expected.what_this_means: Manufacturer/model targets take precedence over generic rules of thumb.
expected.next_action_check: Compare the measured value with the applicable model target and charging procedure.
troubleshooting_path: Reassess charge only from applicable target
must_not_conclude: Do not use a generic target when an applicable model target exists.

cases.title: Suspect evaporator outlet pressure reading

expected.system_check_result: Verify the suspect pressure measurement before diagnosing
confirmed_findings: Evaporator outlet pressure measurement is suspect
expected.what_this_means: Bad pressure evidence can create a false superheat diagnosis.
expected.next_action_check: Verify gauge/transducer connection and pressure at the correct location, then recalculate superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the TXV or charge from a suspect pressure reading.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Warm room with normal suction and head

expected.system_check_result: Warm-room problem is not yet localized to refrigeration circuit
confirmed_findings: Suction and head are reasonable for current state/load
expected.what_this_means: Normal pressures shift attention toward load, airflow, controls, infiltration and capacity.
expected.next_action_check: Check evaporator airflow, door/load conditions, sensor/control accuracy and actual capacity before opening the refrigerant circuit.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant because the room is warm.

cases.title: Low suction with low evaporator load

expected.system_check_result: Low suction may be load-related rather than a feed fault
expected.what_this_means: Low load can lower evaporating pressure without proving a restriction or low charge.
expected.next_action_check: Confirm room/load condition and evaluate superheat/liquid-side evidence before diagnosing refrigerant starvation.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from low suction alone.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High head just after warm pull-down begins

expected.system_check_result: High head may reflect temporary high load
expected.what_this_means: A heavy pull-down load can temporarily raise condensing pressure.
expected.next_action_check: Trend head pressure as box/product temperature falls; verify it returns toward expected range.
troubleshooting_path: Investigate persistent high head only after load decreases
must_not_conclude: Do not immediately diagnose overcharge or noncondensables during known heavy pull-down.

cases.title: Low SH with verified low evaporator load

expected.system_check_result: Low superheat requires load-aware interpretation
expected.what_this_means: Low load can alter valve/feed behavior; floodback risk still must be checked.
expected.next_action_check: Verify stable conditions, bulb/valve response and compressor inlet superheat before adjusting charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not add or remove refrigerant from low SH alone.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Sight-glass bubbles during low ambient

expected.system_check_result: Sight-glass bubbles need low-ambient/head-control context
confirmed_findings: Low ambient/head-pressure control context is present
expected.what_this_means: Low condensing pressure or head-control behavior can cause flash gas without proving low total charge.
expected.next_action_check: Verify head-pressure control operation, liquid pressure/subcooling and receiver condition before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from bubbles alone.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High current with normal head

expected.system_check_result: High compressor current needs electrical/mechanical isolation
expected.what_this_means: High current without high head is not explained by condenser load alone.
expected.next_action_check: Verify voltage/phase condition, start/run components where applicable, compressor temperature and mechanical condition against nameplate data.
must_not_conclude: Do not blame high head when head pressure is normal.

cases.title: High SH + high SC + low suction

expected.system_check_result: Restriction or underfeeding is favored over low charge
expected.what_this_means: Refrigerant is retained on the high side while the evaporator is starved, which fits restriction/underfeeding better than low inventory.
expected.next_action_check: Localize liquid-line/TXV restriction using drier drop, liquid pressure/temperature and TXV inlet/equalizer checks.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant simply because suction is low and SH is high.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High SH + low SC + confirmed restriction

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed restriction takes priority over charge pattern
confirmed_findings: Drier temperature drop localizes a restriction
expected.what_this_means: A localized restriction is direct evidence and can coexist with low-looking subcooling.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the filter-drier restriction first, then stabilize and remeasure before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting the confirmed restriction.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Low SH + high suction with airflow normal

expected.system_check_result: Possible overfeeding/flooding pattern
confirmed_findings: Suction pressure is high for load
expected.what_this_means: With airflow not causing the pattern, excess feed or TXV control should be investigated.
expected.next_action_check: Check TXV bulb installation/response and liquid feed; verify compressor inlet superheat before adjusting charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not assume low airflow when airflow is verified normal.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High suction + low head + weak differential

expected.system_check_result: Weak compressor pumping is strongly indicated
expected.what_this_means: A running compressor that cannot maintain normal pressure separation may have internal leakage or reduced pumping capacity.
expected.next_action_check: Verify operating conditions and compressor current, then evaluate internal valve/leakage evidence before condemning compressor.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to correct weak pressure separation.

cases.title: Low suction + low head + bubbles + no leak evidence

expected.system_check_result: Low refrigerant inventory is plausible but needs confirmation
expected.what_this_means: The combination supports inadequate liquid inventory more than a localized restriction, but leak evidence should be sought.
expected.next_action_check: Check applicable charge reference and perform leak inspection before correcting charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not treat sight-glass bubbles alone as proof of low charge.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High head + high SC + normal airflow + noncondensable evidence

expected.system_check_result: Noncondensables are supported by direct evidence
expected.what_this_means: Normal airflow removes a common heat-rejection cause; direct noncondensable evidence should drive the service path.
expected.next_action_check: Recover/handle refrigerant per proper service procedure, evacuate correctly and recharge by approved method.
must_not_conclude: Do not simply vent or bleed refrigerant to reduce head pressure.

cases.title: High head + high SC + normal airflow + overcharge evidence

expected.system_check_result: Excess refrigerant inventory is supported
expected.what_this_means: With airflow normal and direct charge evidence, excess inventory is more likely than an airflow fault.
expected.next_action_check: Verify applicable charge procedure and correct refrigerant inventory using proper recovery/service methods.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose noncondensables without supporting evidence.

cases.title: High head with dirty coil and high ambient

expected.system_check_result: Condenser heat-rejection problem has two active contributors
expected.what_this_means: Dirty coil and high ambient both increase condensing temperature; correct the serviceable airflow fault first and interpret remaining head against ambient.
expected.next_action_check: Clean the condenser, verify fan/airflow, then compare condensing split against the actual ambient.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge before restoring condenser heat rejection.

cases.title: High SH + proper TXV liquid + bulb good + no response

expected.system_check_result: TXV underfeeding/control fault is localized
expected.what_this_means: Adequate inlet liquid plus valve non-response shifts the fault toward the TXV/control mechanism.
expected.next_action_check: Verify bulb/equalizer/application, then service or replace the TXV if non-response is confirmed.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant when proper liquid is already verified at the TXV.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High SH + flashing at TXV + drier drop

expected.system_check_result: Upstream liquid-line restriction is indicated
expected.what_this_means: The TXV is being supplied with poor liquid condition because an upstream restriction is localized.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the drier/liquid-line restriction first and recheck TXV inlet condition and superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the TXV before restoring proper inlet liquid.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Startup transient high suction

expected.system_check_result: Startup pressure is not yet a steady-state diagnosis
confirmed_findings: High suction occurs during startup after long off-cycle
expected.what_this_means: Startup pressures can be temporarily abnormal while load and refrigerant distribution normalize.
expected.next_action_check: Allow stable cooling, then remeasure suction/head/SH/SC before diagnosing.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose compressor inefficiency from startup suction alone.

cases.title: Defrost active with low suction

expected.system_check_result: Ignore steady-cooling pressure diagnosis during defrost
expected.what_this_means: Defrost is not a valid state for ordinary refrigeration pressure-pattern diagnosis.
expected.next_action_check: Complete defrost and post-defrost recovery, then measure during stable cooling.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from defrost suction pressure.

cases.title: Post-defrost low SH with fan delay active

expected.system_check_result: Post-defrost superheat is not yet stable evidence
expected.what_this_means: Refrigerant and coil conditions are transient immediately after defrost.
expected.next_action_check: Allow fan delay to complete and system to stabilize before evaluating superheat.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust TXV or charge from immediate post-defrost SH.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Pump-down with LP control open

expected.system_check_result: LP opening may be normal pump-down sequence
expected.what_this_means: The compressor is expected to pump suction down until the LP control opens in many pump-down systems.
expected.next_action_check: Verify the actual control sequence and that the compressor stops at the intended cutout.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose an LP-control fault solely because it opens during normal pump-down.

cases.title: Satisfied/off with low suction

expected.system_check_result: Off-cycle suction is not a steady-cooling diagnostic
confirmed_findings: Low suction is observed while cooling is satisfied/off
expected.what_this_means: Pressures equalize/change when the system is off; steady-cooling patterns do not apply.
expected.next_action_check: Wait for a cooling call and stable operation before interpreting suction pressure.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low charge from an off-cycle suction reading.

cases.title: Defrost heater voltage present and current absent

expected.system_check_result: Defrost heater/load circuit failure is localized
expected.what_this_means: Voltage with no current indicates an open heater/load circuit or connection rather than a missing command.
expected.next_action_check: With power isolated, check heater resistance/continuity and wiring connections.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the defrost controller when it is supplying heater voltage.

cases.title: Defrost completes but drain refreezes

expected.system_check_result: Drain/pan heat or drainage problem remains after successful defrost
expected.what_this_means: The coil defrost function works; refreezing points to drainage, drain heat or routing/insulation.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect drain heater, trap/slope, blockage and drain-line routing after confirming safe power isolation.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the defrost heater solely because drain water refreezes.

cases.title: Fan delay active immediately after defrost

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator fan delay is an expected post-defrost state
expected.what_this_means: Fans may remain off until the coil cools to prevent blowing heat/moisture into the box.
expected.next_action_check: Verify fan delay terminates at the intended condition/time before diagnosing a fan fault.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the evaporator fan while intentional fan delay is active.

cases.title: Startup after long off-cycle with hot compressor

expected.system_check_result: Startup/migration history requires compressor-protection checks
confirmed_findings: Long off-cycle startup context is present
expected.what_this_means: Migration or liquid return can dilute oil and stress the compressor at startup.
expected.next_action_check: Check crankcase heater/off-cycle protection and observe startup for liquid-return evidence before repeated starts.
must_not_conclude: Do not repeatedly restart a compressor with suspected liquid slugging.

cases.title: Post-defrost abnormal pressures that normalize

expected.system_check_result: Post-defrost pressure transient requires stabilization
expected.what_this_means: Heat added during defrost can temporarily raise load and pressures.
expected.next_action_check: Trend readings through recovery and diagnose only if abnormal values persist in stable cooling.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose overcharge from a transient post-defrost high head.

cases.title: Cooling demand but contactor coil dead

expected.system_check_result: Control circuit is open upstream of the contactor coil
expected.what_this_means: The failure is in the control path or safety chain before the contactor coil, not yet the compressor power circuit.
expected.next_action_check: Use the actual wiring diagram and trace control voltage through safeties/controllers to the coil.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace contactor power contacts or compressor before finding why the coil is dead.

cases.title: Contactor coil energized but no load-side voltage

expected.system_check_result: Contactor power contacts or supply path are faulty
confirmed_findings: Contactor does not pass line voltage
expected.what_this_means: The command reaches the contactor but power is not delivered through it.
expected.next_action_check: With safe electrical procedures, verify line-side voltage and contact resistance/condition; replace defective contactor as appropriate.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn compressor before verifying voltage reaches it.

cases.title: Correct compressor voltage but no start + start fault

expected.system_check_result: Compressor start circuit fault is localized
expected.what_this_means: The compressor is being supplied but the start circuit is defective.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the identified start component/wiring fault, then verify starting current and operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the compressor before correcting the localized start-circuit fault.

cases.title: Fuse open with cause unknown

expected.system_check_result: Open fuse is a symptom; find the cause before replacement
expected.what_this_means: A fuse can open from short circuit, grounded component, wiring fault or overcurrent.
expected.next_action_check: De-energize and inspect/test the protected circuit for shorts/grounds/failed loads before replacing the fuse.
must_not_conclude: Do not repeatedly replace a fuse without finding why it opened.

cases.title: HP safety open with condenser fan stopped

expected.system_check_result: Condenser airflow fault likely caused the HP trip
expected.what_this_means: Loss of condenser airflow raises condensing pressure until the safety opens.
expected.next_action_check: Find why the condenser fan stopped, restore airflow, then reset/retest per equipment procedure.
must_not_conclude: Do not bypass the high-pressure safety.

cases.title: Overload open on hot compressor

expected.system_check_result: Compressor protection opened because an overheating/overcurrent cause remains
expected.what_this_means: The overload is protecting the compressor; the cause must be found before repeated restart.
expected.next_action_check: Allow safe cooling, then check voltage/current, head pressure, refrigerant return and compressor condition before restart.
must_not_conclude: Do not bypass the overload or repeatedly reset it.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded open with voltage but no flow

expected.system_check_result: Liquid solenoid mechanical/flow fault is localized
expected.what_this_means: The electrical command is present; the remaining fault is valve/mechanical/restriction related.
expected.next_action_check: Verify coil magnetism/valve orientation and pressure differential, then inspect/service the valve.
must_not_conclude: Do not blame thermostat/control command when correct coil voltage is present.

cases.title: Solenoid commanded closed but flow continues

expected.system_check_result: Liquid solenoid is leaking/stuck open
expected.what_this_means: Flow despite a close command indicates valve leakage, debris or mechanical failure.
expected.next_action_check: Verify command/voltage state and inspect/service the solenoid valve seat/plunger.
must_not_conclude: Do not adjust refrigerant charge to compensate for a leaking solenoid.

cases.title: Anti-short-cycle delay active with demand

expected.system_check_result: Compressor off-time delay is intentionally preventing restart
expected.what_this_means: A configured delay can intentionally hold the compressor off to protect it.
expected.next_action_check: Verify the configured delay and allow it to expire; confirm compressor starts afterward.
must_not_conclude: Do not bypass the delay or condemn the compressor while the delay is active.

cases.title: LP control opens too early during cooling

expected.system_check_result: LP control setting/operation may be preventing adequate cooling
confirmed_findings: Room is warm with cooling demand
expected.what_this_means: An LP control that opens above the intended cutout can prematurely stop refrigeration.
expected.next_action_check: Compare cut-in/cutout to the application and actual suction pressure; verify sensing line/control calibration before adjustment or replacement.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant merely to keep an incorrectly set LP control closed.

cases.title: Evap fan stopped + dirty condenser + warm room

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator fan fault is primary, with dirty condenser also active
expected.what_this_means: Both airflow faults matter; the stopped evaporator fan directly prevents heat pickup and should be addressed first without losing the condenser finding.
expected.next_action_check: Repair evaporator fan operation first, then clean/verify condenser airflow and reassess cooling.
must_not_conclude: Do not drop the dirty condenser finding after selecting the evaporator fan as primary.

cases.title: Dirty condenser + sensor error + high load

expected.system_check_result: Multiple independent problems are active
expected.what_this_means: Heat rejection, control accuracy and load can all affect performance; one finding does not erase the others.
expected.next_action_check: Correct condenser airflow and sensor accuracy, account for the temporary load, then reassess stable performance.
must_not_conclude: Do not force all symptoms into a single refrigerant-charge diagnosis.

cases.title: Iced coil + fan stopped + drain refreeze

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator airflow fault with a separate drainage/refreeze issue
expected.what_this_means: The fan fault can contribute to icing, while drain refreeze is a separate condition that also needs correction.
expected.next_action_check: Restore fan operation, clear/defrost coil safely, then inspect drain heat/path before returning to service.
must_not_conclude: Do not treat drain refreeze as proof of a failed defrost heater.

cases.title: High SH + drier drop + TXV bulb fault

expected.system_check_result: Two starvation causes are directly observed
expected.what_this_means: Both an upstream restriction and bad TXV sensing input can starve the evaporator.
expected.next_action_check: Correct both known faults, then stabilize and remeasure before judging charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant before correcting the known restriction and bulb fault.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High head + fan stopped + overcharge evidence

expected.system_check_result: Restore condenser airflow before judging remaining overcharge evidence
expected.what_this_means: A stopped fan is an immediate high-head cause; charge interpretation should be repeated after airflow is restored.
expected.next_action_check: Repair condenser fan first, then stabilize and reassess head/subcooling and the independent overcharge evidence.
must_not_conclude: Do not recover refrigerant solely to lower head while condenser airflow is failed.

cases.title: Low-charge pattern + confirmed leak + drier restriction

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed leak and liquid-line restriction are both active
expected.what_this_means: Low inventory and restriction can coexist; both direct findings must be resolved before final charge evaluation.
expected.next_action_check: Repair leak and restriction using proper service procedures, evacuate/recharge appropriately, then verify stable readings.
must_not_conclude: Do not correct charge alone and leave the restriction or leak unresolved.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Sensor error + refrigeration normal + warm room

expected.system_check_result: Control/sensing problem is favored over refrigerant fault
expected.what_this_means: If refrigeration performance is normal but sensing is wrong, the control may be responding to bad information.
expected.next_action_check: Compare sensor to independent reference, inspect placement/wiring and calibrate/replace as appropriate.
must_not_conclude: Do not open the refrigerant circuit when refrigeration performance is verified normal.

cases.title: High product load + normal refrigeration + long runtime

expected.system_check_result: Long runtime is explained by temporary high load
confirmed_findings: Large warm product load is present
expected.what_this_means: A large load can legitimately extend runtime even when the system is healthy.
expected.next_action_check: Track box/product temperature and confirm pull-down progresses; reassess after load normalizes.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn the compressor solely for long runtime during a verified high load.

cases.title: Load exceeds capacity with all major functions normal

expected.system_check_result: Cooling load exceeds available system capacity
expected.what_this_means: A correctly operating system cannot maintain setpoint when the load exceeds its available capacity.
expected.next_action_check: Quantify load and equipment capacity; reduce load or correct equipment sizing/design rather than adjusting charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to fix an undersized system.

cases.title: Unknown state + direct condenser fan fault

expected.system_check_result: Condenser fan is not running
confirmed_findings: Condenser fan is directly observed not operating
expected.what_this_means: A direct physical airflow fault should not be hidden merely because operating state is not yet confirmed.
expected.next_action_check: With power safely isolated, check fan mechanical freedom; then verify fan command/voltage and capacitor/motor as applicable.
must_not_conclude: Do not make operating-state confirmation the only primary action when a direct fan fault is observed.

cases.title: Moisture indicator wet with otherwise normal operation

expected.system_check_result: Moisture contamination requires service attention even if cooling appears normal
expected.what_this_means: Moisture can cause acid, ice/restriction and reliability problems before obvious performance loss.
expected.next_action_check: Verify indicator condition and system history; correct moisture source and replace drier/evacuate per proper service practice as needed.
must_not_conclude: Do not ignore a wet moisture indicator merely because temperatures are currently normal.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: TXV hunting with head-control instability

expected.system_check_result: Stabilize liquid/head conditions before condemning TXV
expected.what_this_means: Unstable condensing/liquid conditions can drive unstable TXV feed.
expected.next_action_check: Correct head-pressure control instability first, then reassess superheat and TXV response under stable liquid supply.
must_not_conclude: Do not replace the TXV before stabilizing its inlet conditions.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: Uneven evaporator feed with proper inlet liquid

expected.system_check_result: Evaporator distribution/feed problem needs localization
expected.what_this_means: Uneven distribution can come from distributor/nozzle/circuit restriction or valve/feed issues even with good inlet liquid.
expected.next_action_check: Inspect distributor/nozzle/circuit temperatures and TXV application/feeding before adjusting charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not diagnose low total charge solely from an uneven frost pattern.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High discharge temperature + low suction + high SH

expected.system_check_result: Compressor overheating is consistent with evaporator starvation/high compression stress
expected.what_this_means: Low mass flow and high compression ratio can overheat the compressor; the starvation cause must be isolated.
expected.next_action_check: Protect the compressor and check liquid supply, restriction/TXV feed and charge/leak evidence before continued operation.
must_not_conclude: Do not keep running a compressor above its temperature limit while troubleshooting.

sources.name: Parker Sporlan expansion valve and refrigeration troubleshooting guidance

cases.title: High current + high head + dirty condenser

expected.system_check_result: High compressor load is consistent with poor condenser heat rejection
expected.what_this_means: A dirty condenser raises condensing pressure and compressor workload/current.
expected.next_action_check: Clean condenser and verify airflow, then recheck head pressure and compressor current against ratings.
must_not_conclude: Do not condemn compressor from high current before correcting the known high-head cause.

cases.title: Compressor hot but head not excessive

expected.system_check_result: Compressor overheating needs causes beyond high head
expected.what_this_means: Overheating can result from electrical problems, high compression ratio/low suction, inadequate cooling or internal problems even without high head.
expected.next_action_check: Check voltage/current, suction/compression ratio, return-gas conditions and overload history.
must_not_conclude: Do not assume condenser/high head is the cause when head is not excessive.

cases.title: Low ambient + low head + head control installed

expected.system_check_result: Low-ambient head-pressure control performance should be checked
expected.what_this_means: The control should maintain sufficient liquid pressure under low ambient; low head suggests control/setup/inventory issues.
expected.next_action_check: Verify control mode/setting, fan cycling or flooding action and required receiver/flood charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not automatically add refrigerant without verifying head-control design and operation.

cases.title: High head with clean coil and normal airflow

expected.system_check_result: High head remains after condenser airflow causes are excluded
expected.what_this_means: With airflow verified, investigate ambient/load, overcharge, noncondensables or other condensing-side causes.
expected.next_action_check: Verify ambient/load and discriminate overcharge from noncondensables using applicable charge/subcooling and service evidence.
must_not_conclude: Do not keep cleaning or replacing condenser airflow components that are verified normal.

cases.title: Warm room + normal refrigeration + door infiltration

expected.system_check_result: Confirmed infiltration is the primary warm-room load
expected.what_this_means: Warm humid air entering the box can exceed load expectations even when the refrigeration circuit is healthy.
expected.next_action_check: Correct the door/gasket/infiltration source, then verify pull-down before changing refrigerant settings.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant to compensate for a confirmed infiltration load.

cases.title: Conflicting high-head and low-charge clues

expected.system_check_result: Evidence conflicts; do not force a single charge diagnosis
expected.what_this_means: The starvation clues suggest poor liquid supply, while high head conflicts with a simple low-charge pattern; multiple faults or operating conditions may be involved.
expected.next_action_check: Verify operating state, condenser airflow/ambient and liquid-line restriction/leak evidence before changing charge.
must_not_conclude: Do not add refrigerant solely because SH is high and SC is low when high head is unexplained.
